Definition: properly, hinder; generally, next, other, etc.
BiblicalUsage: Acher means other, another, next — the word for what is not this one. "Thou shalt have no other gods before me"; Noah waited "yet other seven days" before sending the dove again; Isaac's servants "digged another well." It is one of the commonest words in the Bible, doing humble work in commandments, calendars, and wells.
TheologicalSignificance: The word for 'other' is too small to build on, and its weight comes entirely from the commandment it serves — no other gods before the Lord.
RelatedEvents: The Ten Commandments; Noah and the Flood
